mentions.name: mcp-bitbucket
mentions.description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Bitbucket written in Go, built as a learning project with an emphasis on a clean, security-conscious codebase, in contrast to existing vibe-coded MCP servers; work in progress.
mentions.problem: Existing MCP servers lack clean codebases and appear vibe-coded, which was a concern at a security-focused company.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am implementing my own MCP server in Go for Bitbucket. This is more of a learning project for me (I was curious about MCP servers), but I also didn't find any MCP servers that have a clean codebase. Many seem to be vibe-coded, and as I work at a company where security is really important, I thought I would implement my own. (Still a WIP: https://github.com/pid0x17/mcp-bitbucket).
mentions.author: pid0x17
